subject: english
question: What is the closest meaning of "geodesics" in the context of the passage?

options.text: Straightest possible paths in curved space-time
Circular orbits caused by gravitational pull
Fixed points of measurement in space-time

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. straightest possible paths in curved space-time. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The term **"geodesics"** in the context of general relativity and curved space-time refers to the shortest or the straightest possible paths between two points in a curved space-time framework. • **Example:** In the presence of a massive object, the geodesics of space-time appear curved, though they represent the straightest possible paths in that curved geometry. • **Straightest possible paths in curved space-time** accurately captures the meaning of "geodesics," as it conveys the concept of the most direct routes within the curved space-time fabric. • The other options, such as gravitational waves, circular orbits, and fixed points of measurement, do not specifically define the shortest or direct paths described by "geodesics." Therefore, the closest meaning of "geodesics" in the context of the passage is: **straightest possible paths in curved space-time.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options and their meanings: • **Gravitational waves moving through space** (अंतरिक्ष के माध्यम से चलने वाली गुरुत्वाकर्षण तरंगें): Ripples in the fabric of space-time caused by the acceleration of massive objects. • **Circular orbits caused by gravitational pull** (गुरुत्वाकर्षण खिंचाव के कारण वृत्ताकार कक्षाएँ): Paths followed by bodies under the influence of a central gravitational force, often taking the form of elliptical or circular trajectories. • **Fixed points of measurement in space-time** (अंतरिक्ष-समय में माप के स्थिर बिंदु): Specific locations in space-time that serve as reference points for various measurements, not directly related to the concept of geodesics. 34:T720, The correct answer is **option 1.**
